title: CI deploy workflows are cancelled by concurrency when one merge triggers ThinTurn, ControlPlane and the image build together
description: Observed after the Phase 2a merges (PRs 516, 517, 518): a single merge to develop triggers the ThinTurn deploy, the ControlPlane deploy and the computer image build at once, and GitHub concurrency cancels or displaces some of them (one pending run per group). Fix: separate concurrency groups per workflow, or sequence them (image first, then Lambdas, or the reverse), without cancelling in-progress deploys. Related: chatticus-96e12b (same family, image build vs Lambda deploys).

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR 543: own concurrency group per development workflow (deploy-auth, deploy-controlplane, deploy-thinturn, deploy-web with -development suffix, and build-computer-image-development), cancel-in-progress false, each deploy pinned to the triggering sha, deploy script waits out IN_PROGRESS stacks since ThinTurn and Web workflows also deploy control-plane, structural guards in infra/test/deploy-workflows.test.ts, AGENTS.md updated. Image tag order stays with chatticus-d88a0f. Live proof: next merge to develop, all five workflows succeed with none cancelled.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged PR 543 (separate concurrency group per development workflow, pinned checkout, stack wait) and PR 545 (synth once, bounded retry only on 'is in ...IN_PROGRESS state and can not be updated', no retry for other errors). Live results on 2026-10-14: the PR 543 merge ran Auth, ControlPlane, ThinTurn and the image build with ZERO cancellations; the Web deploy hit the check-then-act race (ChatticusWeb UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS from the ThinTurn workflow) which PR 545 fixes; the PR 545 merge ran Auth, ControlPlane, ThinTurn and Web, all success, no cancellations. Not yet seen live: the retry path actually firing. Keep open until a merge shows 'is UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS ... waiting' or a retry message in a deploy log, or close on the next fully green overlapping merge.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closing: PRs 543, 545 and 548 merged. Live on development 2026-10-14: the merge of PR 548 and 549 (3c1e7660) ran CI, Auth, ControlPlane, ThinTurn, Web and the image build and all six succeeded, none cancelled or colliding; each development stack is now deployed by exactly one workflow, each workflow has its own concurrency group, deploys check out the commit that triggered them, and the deploy script synthesizes once and retries only on the overlapping-deploy messages. A pending run replaced by a later commit's run is by design. The retry path itself has not fired live (it is covered by stub tests); reopen if a deploy log shows a retry that fails.
